# garage_bucket_alias (Resource)

Manages a Garage bucket alias (global or local).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Global alias
resource "garage_bucket_alias" "cdn" {
  bucket_id  = garage_bucket.website.id
  alias_type = "global"
  name       = "cdn-alias"
}

# Local alias scoped to an access key
resource "garage_bucket_alias" "app_local" {
  bucket_id     = garage_bucket.data.id
  alias_type    = "local"
  name          = "app-data"
  access_key_id = garage_key.app.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias_type` (String) Type of alias: 'global' or 'local'.
- `bucket_id` (String) ID of the bucket.
- `name` (String) Alias name.

### Optional

- `access_key_id` (String) Access key ID for local aliases. Required when alias_type is 'local'.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Global alias
terraform import garage_bucket_alias.cdn <bucket-id>:global:<alias-name>

# Local alias
terraform import garage_bucket_alias.app_local <bucket-id>:local:<key-id>:<alias-name>
```
